SELF-ATTENTION · VISUAL OVERVIEW

Every token can use context from other tokens

One token forms a query, compares against visible keys, then gathers a weighted mixture of their values. Context changes its representation.

PRONOUN COREFERENCE ATTENTION SPOTLIGHT

Which noun does “it” refer to? Context guides the signal

questions.stem: Python, PyTorchలో Trainable Q/K/V Projections, Matrix Multiplication, Optional Masks, Attention Weights, Token-to-Token Heatmapతో Self-Attention Layer ఎలా Build చేస్తాం?
questions.figure:
PYTORCH QKV PROJECTION AND CAUSAL HEATMAP

Implement learned projections, optional masking, and attention weights

self_attention.py · PyTorch
import math, torch
from torch import nn

torch.manual_seed(7)
class SelfAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.q = nn.Linear(dim, dim, bias=False)
        self.k = nn.Linear(dim, dim, bias=False)
        self.v = nn.Linear(dim, dim, bias=False)

    def forward(self, x, causal=False):
        Q, K, V = self.q(x), self.k(x), self.v(x)
        scores = Q @ K.transpose(-2, -1)
        scores = scores / math.sqrt(K.shape[-1])
        if causal:
            n = x.size(-2)
            allowed = torch.ones(n, n, dtype=torch.bool, device=x.device).tril()
            scores = scores.masked_fill(~allowed, float("-inf"))
        weights = scores.softmax(dim=-1)
        return weights @ V, weights

x = torch.randn(1, 4, 8)
out, attention = SelfAttention(8)(x, causal=True)
print(out.shape, attention.shape)
print(attention[0].round(decimals=2))
Token-to-token attention

Heatmap is illustrative; the code prints its actual random-initialized weights.

Hands-on: The snippet creates Q/K/V with trainable matrices, calculates attention, and masks future positions when requested. No pretrained model is needed.

questions.stem: BERT Bidirectional Self-Attention, GPT Causal Self-Attention మధ్య Masks, Token Visibility, Positions, Multi-Head Projections, Context Length Differences ఏమిటి?
questions.figure:
BERT VERSUS GPT VISIBILITY HEATMAPS

Visibility matrices: full context or past-only context?

Architecture: Bidirectional attention can use both sides of a token in the input. Causal decoding forbids future tokens. Heads learn different projections, and longer context increases full-attention cost.
options: BERT Right Side Hide, GPT Generationలో Future Tokens See చేస్తుందంటుంది. Usual Attention Visibility Rules Reverse.
BERT, GPT Same Attention Mask, Vocabulary Size మాత్రమే Different అంటుంది. Their Training Objectives, Directions Also Differ.
BERT, GPTకి Position Information అవసరం లేదంటుంది. Attention Alone Token Orderని Know చేయదు.
BERT Commonly Bidirectional Input Context Use చేస్తుంది; GPT Future Positions Causal Maskతో Block చేసి Next Token Predict చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Explanation: Incomplete Newspaper Headlineని Imagine చేయండి. BERT-style Model Hidden Word Learn లేదా Understand చేసేటప్పుడు Earlier, Later Words Both చూడగలదు. GPT-style Model మాత్రం Earlier Tokens ఆధారంగా Next Token Predict చేస్తుంది. Difference Attention Masksలో — Bidirectional vs Causal. Both Models Position Information, Multiple Attention Heads Use చేస్తాయి. More Contextతో More History Consider చేయవచ్చు; అయితే Attention, Memory Costs కూడా Grow అవుతాయి.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct: D. BERT-style Bidirectional Encoder Earlier, Later Tokens Attend చేయవచ్చు; GPT Causal Decoder Future Positions Block చేస్తుంది. Both Position Information, Multiple Heads Use చేస్తాయి. Long Context More Info, More Attention Cost.

questions.stem: Large-Scale Transformersలో Self-Attention Quadratic Compute, KV Cache Memory Challengesని FlashAttention, Sparse Attention, Cachingతో ఎలా Optimize చేస్తాం? Speed, Quality Trade-offs ఎలా Evaluate చేస్తాం?
questions.figure:
FLASHATTENTION TILING KV CACHE AND SPARSITY

Long-context optimization: tiles, cache reuse, and sparse patterns

Trade-off: FlashAttention is exact full attention with less memory traffic, not a subquadratic algorithm. KV caching helps decoding, while sparse patterns reduce work but can miss relevant tokens.
options: FlashAttention Tiled Memory Traffic Reduce చేస్తుంది; KV Cache Decodingలో Past Values Reuse; Sparse Patterns Some Links Skip చేస్తాయి.
FlashAttention Every Pairwise Computation Remove, KV Cache All Training Memory Eliminate చేస్తుందంటుంది. Neither Is Cost-Free.
Sparse Attention Fewer Comparisonsతో Exact Dense Links Maintain చేస్తుందంటుంది. Skipped Links Visible Information Change చేస్తాయి.
KV Cache Generation Start తర్వాత All Earlier Tokens Delete చేస్తుందంటుంది. Normally Earlier Reusable K/V Store చేస్తుంది.
